Subject: Trial stipend suspense release — journal instructions and invoice offset request

Hi Laura / Marcus,

Quick one: HelioWorks (HEL-7893) received a $25,000 trial stipend that was booked to our promotional suspense account (subledger 7100) while the pilot completed. The customer has requested that we apply the stipend as an offset against their outstanding invoice INV-5543 rather than issuing a separate credit memo. They also signed a 30‑day trial extension (SOW attached) and will top up usage next week.

Attachments: helio_trial_stipend.csv (allocation detail), SOW_HelioWorks_v2.pdf (signed)

Can finance advise the preferred path for month-end close? Two options I see:
- Create a credit memo for $25k and apply it to INV-5543 (standard AR process), or
- Post a JE that moves the $25k from suspense to contra revenue and apply a manual invoice offset in the billing system (ERP flagging).

Helio asked for this to be reflected on their May statement — any chance we can prioritize? If you need anything else from my side (customer PO, signed SOW, HubSpot link), I can pull it now.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 02 May 2028 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial stipend suspense release — journal instructions and invoice offset request

Karthik — thanks for the detail and attachments. A couple of follow-ups before we execute:

1) Region / tax: you show HelioWorks as a US customer in HubSpot; confirm billing address is CA (California) vs. international? Tax treatment can affect whether we net via JE or issue a credit memo.
2) Revenue recognition: was this stipend recorded as a contra-revenue (we used code 4001) or as a promotional expense earlier? Marcus, can you confirm the current GL posting for the $25k?
3) Application method: Finance preference is to issue a credit memo applied to the invoice for transparency on the AR ledger. A JE is acceptable only if we have a clear audit trail and the customer agrees in writing to invoice netting.

If Karthik can confirm billing jurisdiction and confirm HelioWorks is ok with invoice netting, we can route a short approval. If they want the net reflected on the May statement, we need sign-off and the docu-sign link to the SOW (or an email from the customer authorizing offset).

I can expedite a credit memo today if you confirm. If you prefer JE + offset, Marcus will need to prepare the journal and provide the supporting files for audit.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Thanks, Laura. Confirmed: HelioWorks is US/CA (billing address: 420 Mission St, San Francisco, CA). Julia below confirms they prefer the offset on INV-5543 rather than a separate credit memo to keep their accounts tidy. Julia: can you reply with a short written authorization to net the stipend vs the invoice? That will help with audit.

Also noting the customer requested the May statement to reflect the net — their billing cutoff is May 5. We are pushing the SOW through DocuSign now (link in related_links).

Next steps I propose:
- Julia to send one-line email authorizing netting (cc Redwood finance)
- Marcus to prepare JE template (GL mappings below) if Finance decides JE + manual offset is the path
- If Laura prefers credit memo, I will notify the customer and proceed with standard CM issuance.

Thanks all — can we aim to close this today?

--
Karthik
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial stipend suspense release — journal instructions and invoice offset request

Thanks Karthik — Julia, thanks in advance for the email confirmation. Per our internal policy and audit requirements we've reviewed both options and can proceed with manual invoice offset provided we have: (1) written authorization from the customer agreeing to net the stipend against INV-5543, and (2) the supporting SOW / allocation ledger attached to the journal.

If those are provided, Finance will:
- Prepare a JE to move $25,000 from Promotional Suspense (subledger 7100) to Promotional Contra (GLA 4001) and Post a balancing entry to AR Clearing (GLA 2109) so the billing team can apply the offset to INV-5543.
- Record the JE with supporting attachments in the month of May and tag the transaction with deal_id HEL-7893 for traceability.

JE template (we attached the editable file): je_template_Q2.xlsx (please use this format)
Suggested GLA mapping for the JE: 
- Debit 7100 (Promotional Suspense) — $25,000
- Credit 4001 (Promotional Contra / Credit Allowance) — $25,000
- Then post AR clearing (2109) as a balancing movement to allow the billing system to reduce INV-5543.

Action items:
- Julia: reply to this thread with authorization to net (one line is fine).
- Karthik / Monica: attach the signed SOW link + helio_trial_stipend.csv to the JE folder in Drive.
- Laura: if you prefer credit memo route instead, let us know and we will generate CM-5543 today.

I'll queue the JE for review once we have the customer confirmation. Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
